requirement_text: System shall be easily updatable for fixes and patches.
rationale: "Easily" is subjective and no update process or target is given.
clarification_questions: What does "easily updatable" mean (time, effort, downtime)?
How are fixes and patches delivered?

requirement_text: The back-end systems (multiple back-end systems may exist for a single card), which communicate with the cards, perform the verifications, and manage the off-card key databases, also shall be trusted.
user_story: As a security architect, I want the back-end systems that communicate with the cards, perform verifications and manage the off-card key databases to be trusted, so that card security does not depend on an untrusted back end.
technical_task: Establish and document trust for every back-end system that communicates with the cards, performs verifications or manages the off-card key databases, including when several back-end systems exist for one card.
acceptance_criteria: Given a back-end system that communicates with the cards, when it is assessed, then it is trusted.
Given a back-end system that performs verifications or manages the off-card key databases, when it is assessed, then it is trusted.
rationale: Role assumed: security architect. What makes a system "trusted" is not defined.

requirement_text: There will be no restriction in time or place for the use of the software built from the specifications produced under this contract.
user_story: As a licensee, I want no restriction in time or place on using the software built from the specifications, so that I can use it anywhere and for as long as I need.
technical_task: Release the software built under the contract without time or location limits on its use.
acceptance_criteria: Given the delivered software, when its license terms are reviewed, then they contain no time restriction.
Given the delivered software, when its license terms are reviewed, then they contain no restriction on the place of use.

requirement_text: System shall send order confirmation to the user and seller through email or SMS.
user_story: As a buyer, I want an order confirmation by email or SMS, so that I know my order was placed.
technical_task: Send an order confirmation to both the user and the seller by email or SMS.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order is placed, when it is completed, then an order confirmation is sent to the user by email or SMS.
Given an order is placed, when it is completed, then an order confirmation is also sent to the seller by email or SMS.
rationale: Role assumed: buyer. Which channel is used when is not stated.

requirement_text: Connector P1 pins 1 and 32 of row d shall be connected to +5V.
requirement_text_raw: Connector P1 pins 1 and 32 of row d shall (3.2.3.1.2.8) be connected to +5V.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want pins 1 and 32 of row d of connector P1 connected to +5V, so that power is supplied on those pins.
technical_task: Wire pins 1 and 32 of row d on connector P1 to +5V.
acceptance_criteria: Given connector P1, when pin 1 of row d is measured, then it is connected to +5V.
Given connector P1, when pin 32 of row d is measured, then it is connected to +5V.

requirement_text: Please refer to the "Telematic5.5 - Diagnostic Specification SV and SPV Display" for details.
requirement_text_raw: Please refer to the "Telematic5.5 - Diagnostic Specification SV and SPV Display" [RD4528] for details.
rationale: The sentence only refers to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Diagnostic Specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to return items to the seller if not satisfied and provide feedback.
user_story: As a customer, I want to return items to the seller if I am not satisfied and give feedback, so that I can get a resolution.
technical_task: Provide a return function that sends items back to the seller, together with a feedback form.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item the customer is not satisfied with, when the customer returns it, then the return is sent to the seller.
Given a returned item, when the customer submits feedback, then the feedback is saved.

requirement_text: User shall be able to track the status of sent snaps, displaying "delivered" or "received" as appropriate.
user_story: As a user, I want to track the status of snaps I sent, shown as "delivered" or "received", so that I know if they arrived.
technical_task: Show the delivery status of each sent snap as "delivered" or "received", whichever applies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sent snap that has been delivered, when the user views its status, then "delivered" is displayed.
Given a sent snap that has been received, when the user views its status, then "received" is displayed.

requirement_text: The interrupts across all channels shall have a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The interrupts across all channels shall (3.4.1.2.6) have a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want interrupts across all channels to have a skew of no more than 330 microseconds, so that channels stay in step.
technical_task: Keep the skew between interrupts on all channels to 330 microseconds or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given interrupts on all channels, when their skew is measured, then it is no greater than 330 microseconds.
Given a measured skew above 330 microseconds, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Users can search for available properties within their budget based on the area covered, city, location, price range, property type, property subtype, and purpose.
user_story: As a home buyer, I want to search available properties within my budget by area, city, location, price range, type, subtype and purpose, so that I find suitable homes.
technical_task: Implement a property search filtered by area covered, city, location, price range, property type, property subtype and purpose, limited to the user's budget.
acceptance_criteria: Given search filters for area, city, location, price range, property type, subtype and purpose, when the user searches, then matching available properties are listed.
Given a property priced above the user's budget, when the user searches, then it is not listed.

requirement_text: System shall store and display the user's comments.
user_story: As a user, I want my comments stored and displayed, so that they remain visible.
technical_task: Store each comment a user writes and display it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a comment is submitted, when it is saved, then it is stored.
Given a stored comment, when the user opens the page, then it is displayed.

requirement_text: A users manual, explaining how to install and operate the MultiMahjongClient, will be provided.
user_story: As a player, I want a users manual explaining how to install and operate the MultiMahjongClient, so that I can set it up and play.
technical_task: Write and ship a users manual that explains installation and operation of the MultiMahjongClient.
acceptance_criteria: Given the delivered software, when it is released, then a users manual is provided.
Given the users manual, when a player reads it, then it explains how to install and how to operate the MultiMahjongClient.

requirement_text: An OK indicator, appearing green, shall signify the absence of any diagnostic conditions.
user_story: As a technician, I want a green OK indicator when no diagnostic conditions exist, so that I can see at a glance that all is well.
technical_task: Show a green OK indicator when there are no diagnostic conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given there are no diagnostic conditions, when the screen is displayed, then an OK indicator appears in green.
Given at least one diagnostic condition, when the screen is displayed, then the OK indicator is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. The second criterion follows from "the absence of any diagnostic conditions".

requirement_text: Sensitive data is not passed in query strings or form fields.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want sensitive data never passed in query strings or form fields, so that it is not exposed in URLs or logs.
technical_task: Keep sensitive data out of query strings and form fields.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data, when a request is sent, then the data is not in the query string.
Given sensitive data, when a form is submitted, then the data is not in a form field.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. The second criterion follows from the requirement's two named places.

requirement_text: System shall support LDAP authentication for user login.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in using LDAP authentication, so that I can use my directory account.
technical_task: Support LDAP authentication for user login.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid LDAP account, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated through LDAP.
Given invalid LDAP credentials, when the user tries to log in, then login is refused.

requirement_text: System shall display the uploaded videos on the user's channel.
user_story: As a creator, I want my uploaded videos shown on my channel, so that viewers can find them.
technical_task: List a user's uploaded videos on that user's channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has uploaded videos, when the channel is opened, then the uploaded videos are displayed.
Given a user who has not uploaded videos, when the channel is opened, then no videos are listed.

requirement_text: The TCS shall allow the operator to command the flight behavior characteristics inherent to the selected AV.
user_story: As an operator, I want to command the flight behavior characteristics that belong to the selected AV, so that I can control it.
technical_task: Allow the operator to send commands for the flight behavior characteristics of the selected AV.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected AV, when the operator commands a flight behavior characteristic of that AV, then the command is sent.
Given a selected AV, when the operator tries to command a characteristic the AV does not have, then the command is not available.

requirement_text: A patient may have at most one height data point one weight data point and one pedometer data point in any one day reported by him or herself a UAP or a personal representative .
requirement_text_raw: A patient may have at most one height data point  one weight data point  and one pedometer data point in any one day  reported by him or herself  a UAP  or a personal representative .
user_story: As a patient, I want to report at most one height, one weight and one pedometer data point per day, so that daily records stay consistent.
technical_task: Allow no more than one height, one weight and one pedometer data point for a patient per day, reported by the patient, a UAP or a personal representative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with no height data point for a day, when the patient, a UAP or a personal representative reports one, then it is saved.
Given a patient who already has a height, weight or pedometer data point for a day, when another of that kind is reported for the same day, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role stated: patient, UAP, personal representative.

requirement_text: For Details about the support of GSM / GPRS radio technology the document `` Remote Vehicle Data Access '' shall be mandatory.
requirement_text_raw: For Details about the support of GSM / GPRS radio technology the document `` Remote Vehicle Data Access '' [RD4117] shall be mandatory.
rationale: The sentence declares a document mandatory and gives no requirement in itself.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced document "Remote Vehicle Data Access" require for GSM / GPRS support?

requirement_text: A supervisor shall be able to do everything a waiter can.
user_story: As a supervisor, I want to do everything a waiter can do, so that I can cover for waiters.
technical_task: Grant supervisors every capability that waiters have.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function available to a waiter, when a supervisor uses it, then it is available to the supervisor too.
Given a supervisor, when the supervisor is compared with a waiter, then the supervisor has no less access.

requirement_text: Employee shall log into the system.
user_story: As an employee, I want to log in to the system, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Provide a login for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee with valid credentials, when the employee logs in, then access is granted.
Given an employee with invalid credentials, when the employee logs in, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to mark individual and groups of files as restricted.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to mark individual files and groups of files as restricted, so that access to them is limited.
technical_task: Add a restricted flag that can be set on a single file or on a group of files.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file, when the archivist marks it as restricted, then it is restricted.
Given a group of files, when the archivist marks the group as restricted, then every file in it is restricted.

requirement_text: User shall receive safety training materials and awareness campaigns within the app, promoting safe behaviors and fostering a culture of responsibility among users.
rationale: The aims ("promoting safe behaviors", "fostering a culture") are not measurable and the content is not specified.
clarification_questions: Which safety topics and campaigns are to be provided?
How is a "culture of responsibility" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall log errors, warnings, and informational messages to an external log file on the application server.
user_story: As an operations engineer, I want errors, warnings and informational messages logged to an external log file on the application server, so that I can diagnose problems.
technical_task: Write error, warning and informational messages to a log file on the application server that is external to the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is written to the external log file on the application server.
Given a warning or informational message is produced, when it is handled, then it is written to the same log file.

requirement_text: Agricultural and animal product producers shall be able to add items for sale with product details such as product name, quantity, product rate, required place, and contact details.
user_story: As a producer, I want to add items for sale with name, quantity, rate, required place and contact details, so that buyers can find my products.
technical_task: Provide an item listing form for agricultural and animal products with product name, quantity, product rate, required place and contact details.
acceptance_criteria: Given the item listing form, when a producer fills in the product details and saves, then the item is listed for sale.
Given a listed item, when it is viewed, then it shows its name, quantity, rate, required place and contact details.
rationale: Role stated: agricultural and animal product producer.

requirement_text: The user is presented with a list of his or her messages in the message inbox.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a list of my messages in the message inbox, so that I can read them.
technical_task: Display the user's messages as a list in the message inbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with messages, when the user opens the inbox, then a list of the user's messages is displayed.
Given a user with no messages, when the user opens the inbox, then the list is empty.

requirement_text: The application itself will only have minimal logic and so there should be little to no issues with the computation required by the phone itself.
rationale: The sentence is a design statement and "little to no issues" has no measurable criterion.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement, or an observation about the application's design?
What computation limits must the phone satisfy?

requirement_text: The Disputes System must provide Search functionality allowing search by dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number, and issuer number, with filtering options by date range, dispute type, case status, and reason code.
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want to search disputes by case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number or issuer number and filter by date range, type, status and reason code, so that I can find cases quickly.
technical_task: Build Disputes System search on dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number and issuer number, with filters for date range, dispute type, case status and reason code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number or issuer number, when the analyst searches, then matching disputes are returned.
Given search results, when the analyst filters by date range, dispute type, case status or reason code, then only matching disputes remain.

requirement_text: An Izogn administrator must be able to update the category listings on the website within 2 minutes.
user_story: As an Izogn administrator, I want to update the category listings on the website within 2 minutes, so that changes are quick.
technical_task: Make updating the website's category listings possible for an Izogn administrator in 2 minutes or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Izogn administrator, when the administrator updates the category listings, then the update can be done within 2 minutes.
Given the updated category listings, when the website is viewed, then the new listings are shown.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records) to provide audit information about additions and changes to the status of destinations and sources.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the solution to conform to function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records), so that I have audit information on additions and changes to the status of destinations and sources.
technical_task: Record audit information for additions and status changes of destinations and sources in line with function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records).
acceptance_criteria: Given a destination or source is added, when the addition is saved, then audit information is recorded.
Given the status of a destination or source changes, when the change is saved, then audit information is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. IN.2.2 is only referenced.

requirement_text: Each method shall include a description of its function and additional information for future use.
user_story: As a developer, I want each method to include a description of its function and additional information, so that future maintainers understand it.
technical_task: Document every method with a description of what it does and extra information for later use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a method in the code, when it is reviewed, then it includes a description of its function.
Given a method in the code, when it is reviewed, then it includes additional information for future use.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. What the additional information covers is not stated.

requirement_text: For details about required WLAN interface see also chapter "WLAN".
rationale: The sentence only points to another chapter.
clarification_questions: What does the chapter "WLAN" require of the WLAN interface?
Is the chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The information and the search methods of the Student Handbook-app will be restricted depending on file format of the handbook-information.
user_story: As a student, I want the Student Handbook-app's information and search methods to depend on the format of the handbook information, so that I get search that suits the file.
technical_task: Restrict the information shown and the search methods offered in the Student Handbook-app according to the file format of the handbook information.
acceptance_criteria: Given handbook information in a given file format, when the student opens the app, then the information shown depends on that file format.
Given handbook information in a given file format, when the student searches, then only the search methods allowed for that file format are offered.
rationale: Role assumed: student. The formats and their restrictions are not listed.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall not solely exceed these timing requirement budgets.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall not (3.1.5) solely exceed these timing requirement budgets.
rationale: The sentence refers to budgets defined elsewhere and its wording ("not solely exceed") is unclear.
clarification_questions: Which timing requirement budgets does "these" refer to?

requirement_text: Adobe Illustrator shall be compatible with a minimum processor of Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64.
user_story: As a designer, I want Adobe Illustrator to be compatible with a minimum processor of Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64, so that it runs on older machines.
technical_task: Ensure Adobe Illustrator runs on a processor at least as capable as an Intel Pentium 4 or an AMD Athlon 64.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computer with an Intel Pentium 4 processor, when Adobe Illustrator is installed, then it runs.
Given a computer with an AMD Athlon 64 processor, when Adobe Illustrator is installed, then it runs.

requirement_text: RAM scrub shall report detected errors to the application, congruently on all channels, via an API service for inclusion in the telemetry stream.
requirement_text_raw: RAM scrub shall [SRS044] report detected errors to the application, congruently on all channels, via an API service for inclusion in the telemetry stream.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want RAM scrub to report detected errors to the application through an API service, identically on all channels, so that errors appear in the telemetry stream.
technical_task: Report errors detected by RAM scrub to the application congruently on all channels through an API service for the telemetry stream.
acceptance_criteria: Given RAM scrub detects an error, when it reports, then the error is reported to the application through an API service.
Given the same error condition on several channels, when RAM scrub reports, then the report is congruent on all channels and can be included in the telemetry stream.

requirement_text: A batch program shall periodically predict diseases based on consultation requests using a machine learning algorithm and prioritize the requests.
user_story: As a doctor, I want a batch program to periodically predict diseases from consultation requests with a machine learning algorithm and prioritize the requests, so that urgent cases are seen first.
technical_task: Run a periodic batch program that uses a machine learning algorithm to predict diseases from consultation requests and orders the requests by priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given consultation requests, when the batch program runs, then it predicts diseases using a machine learning algorithm.
Given predicted diseases, when the batch program finishes, then the consultation requests are prioritized.
rationale: Role assumed: doctor. The run interval and the priority rule are not stated.

requirement_text: Complete the remainder of the form as necessary and click 'Save'.
rationale: The sentence is guidance to a user and has no stated system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a user instruction?
Which parts of the form are "the remainder" and which are necessary?

requirement_text: Users shall be able to contact doctors through email, phone calls, or SMS, providing accurate information for their queries.
user_story: As a patient, I want to contact doctors by email, phone call or SMS, so that I can ask my questions in my preferred way.
technical_task: Offer email, phone call and SMS as ways to contact doctors, and collect accurate information with the query.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor's contact options, when the user opens them, then email, phone call and SMS are offered.
Given a query, when the user submits it through a chosen channel, then the information provided is passed to the doctor.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. "Accurate" information cannot be verified by the system; the criteria only cover passing it on.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register for an individual or business account by providing email, creating password, and confirming password.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register for an individual or business account with an email, a password and a password confirmation, so that I can start using the service.
technical_task: Offer registration for individual and business accounts, asking for an email, a password and a password confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user selects individual or business and provides an email, a password and a matching confirmation, then the account is created.
Given the registration form, when the confirmation does not match the password, then the account is not created.

requirement_text: The predicted power shall be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the predicted power to be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage, so that the prediction is conservative.
technical_task: Compute predicted power from the cell with the lowest voltage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a battery with cells at different voltages, when predicted power is calculated, then it is based on the cell with the lowest voltage.
Given the cell with the lowest voltage changes, when predicted power is calculated again, then it uses the new lowest cell.

requirement_text: The LHCP clicks this number to view the physiologic data monitoring details of his or her patients for the current date.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to click a number to view the physiologic data monitoring details of my patients for the current date, so that I can follow their readings.
technical_task: Make the number clickable so that it opens the physiologic data monitoring details of the LHCP's patients for the current date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the number is displayed, when the LHCP clicks it, then the physiologic data monitoring details of the LHCP's patients are shown.
Given the details are shown, when the LHCP reads them, then they are for the current date.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. What the number represents is not given.

requirement_text: An LHCP selects to view additional information for a patient.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to select to view additional information for a patient, so that I can see more detail.
technical_task: Add a selection that shows additional information for a patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the LHCP selects to view additional information, then the additional information is displayed.
Given the additional information, when it is displayed, then it belongs to the selected patient.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. What the additional information includes is not stated.

requirement_text: If the solution provides the ability for direct entry by the patient then the solution should explicitly label the data as patient entered.
requirement_text_raw: If the solution provides the ability for direct entry by the patient  then the solution should explicitly label the data as patient entered.
user_story: As a clinician, I want data entered directly by the patient labeled as patient entered, so that I know where the data came from.
technical_task: When patients can enter data directly, label that data explicitly as patient entered.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution allows direct entry by the patient, when a patient enters data, then the data is labeled as patient entered.
Given data entered by someone other than the patient, when it is displayed, then it is not labeled as patient entered.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide rate groups that execute at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz., with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second, and with a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS035] provide rate groups that execute at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz., with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second, and with a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to provide 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups with a drift rate of at most 50 microseconds per second and jitter of at most 330 microseconds, so that timing is dependable.
technical_task: Provide 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups in the scheduler with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second and a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the scheduler, when the rate groups run, then there are rate groups executing at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz.
Given a running rate group, when its timing is measured, then the drift rate is no greater than 50 microseconds per second and the jitter is no greater than 330 microseconds.

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall use the information contained in the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling units are part of the THEMAS system.
requirement_text_raw:
The THEMAS system shall use the information contained in the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling
units are part of the THEMAS system.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to use the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling units belong to the system, so that it knows its equipment.
technical_task: Read the initialization data file at start and use it to decide which heating and cooling units are part of the THEMAS system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an initialization data file, when the THEMAS system starts, then it reads the file.
Given a heating or cooling unit listed in the file, when the system determines its units, then that unit is part of the THEMAS system.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to create an account by providing credentials and activating it via email.
user_story: As a new user, I want to create an account with credentials and activate it by email, so that my account is verified.
technical_task: Implement account creation with credentials followed by activation through an email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user provides credentials, when the account is created, then an activation email is sent.
Given an activation email, when the user follows it, then the account is activated.

requirement_text: System shall handle errors effectively to prevent system failures.
rationale: "Effectively" and "errors" are too general to test.
clarification_questions: Which errors must be handled and how?

requirement_text: Authorization login shall be required when the software starts.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in with authorization when the software starts, so that only authorized people use it.
technical_task: Require an authorization login at software start.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software starts, when the user opens it, then a login for authorization is requested.
Given a user who has not logged in, when the user tries to use the software, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: The MET shall be congruent across all FCP members.
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.9) be congruent across all FCP members.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET to be congruent across all FCP members, so that all share the same time.
technical_task: Keep the MET congruent on every FCP member.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP members, when their MET values are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an update to the MET, when it completes, then all FCP members still have congruent MET values.
